# Public transcript

## Opening situation

A busy Singapore hawker centre at lunchtime. Every table in the hawker centre is full and there is no other free seat anywhere. At a small two-seat table, Casey occupies one seat and the other is occupied by Jamie. The seats are fixed stools, so nobody can slide along or share one. There are no loose chairs and no room to add one without blocking the aisle. A small unopened tissue packet rests beside Jamie. The four people are strangers and have not spoken before.

Alex arrives carrying a hot meal and stops at the only disputed seat. Jamie has already placed a tray and uncovered a bowl there. Casey remains in the other seat, while Robin stands nearby carrying food and waiting for whichever seat next becomes available. No one has moved or offered a concrete arrangement yet.

## Round 1

- **Turn 1 — Alex:** Jamie — I left that tissue packet to save my seat. Please move it so I can sit; my food's hot.
- **Turn 2 — Jamie:** I was already sitting; that tissue packet isn't a reservation. My bowl's open and will spill if I move it—please wait a short while and I'll clear my tray when I'm done.

## Round 2

- **Turn 3 — Alex:** Okay — I'll wait, but please clear your tray as soon as you're done so I can sit right after.
- **Turn 5 — Robin:** Alex — I saw you put that tissue packet earlier. I'm waiting too; please don't overlook me when the seat frees up.

## Round 3

- **Turn 6 — Alex:** Robin — I saw you. Jamie agreed to clear the tray soon; I left that packet first, so I'm next. I'll tell you if anything changes.
- **Turn 7 — Robin:** Okay — I'll wait here.
